cohort: 1028 women with term pregnancies in vertex presentation who underwent caesarean section at the second stage of delivery
finding: Breech extraction during second-stage Cesarean section was associated with fewer maternal complications (uterine incision extensions and blood transfusions) compared to attempted cephalic extraction, without increasing neonatal complication rates.
mod_finding: Breech extraction during second-stage cesarean section was associated with fewer maternal complications compared to attempted cephalic extraction.
